_about: AI motion shots for the AQUILO sites. Each starts from the client's REAL product photo, so the product in the video is the actual product; Wan 2.2 only adds motion (water, light, camera).
negative: blurry, low quality, deformed product, warped metal, melting, morphing faucet, changing shape, text, watermark, logo, shaky camera, people, hands, extra objects

shots.prompt: A luxury brass rain shower head mounted on a wall, water falling in fine glittering streams, droplets catching warm golden light, lush green wall softly out of focus, very slow cinematic camera push-in, photorealistic, the shower head stays perfectly still and unchanged

A sculptural white freestanding spa bathtub on a wooden deck at dusk beside a calm sea, candle flames flicker gently, soft ripples on the water surface, the sky glows pink and violet, very slow cinematic camera push-in, photorealistic, the bathtub stays perfectly unchanged

A modern gunmetal basin mixer on a white marble vanity, a clear smooth stream of water flows from the spout into the basin, gentle reflections on the marble, soft daylight, very slow cinematic camera drift, photorealistic, the faucet stays perfectly unchanged
Twin fine mist sprays and a central stream of water falling through darkness, droplets glitter in a beam of light, slow motion, cinematic, photorealistic, deep black background

A cylindrical freestanding basin in matte black with a polished rose gold rim, studio darkness, a soft light slowly sweeps across the rose gold surface creating moving reflections, very slow orbiting camera, photorealistic, product stays perfectly unchanged

A round ceiling rain shower in a dark luxury bathroom, a dense curtain of water droplets falls straight down glowing with soft blue light, steam drifts, slow cinematic camera tilt, photorealistic, the shower head stays perfectly unchanged
